title.en: Oscillator principle: tank circuit and Barkhausen criterion

heading.en: A circuit that makes its own signal

hook.en: Every radio station, every computer clock and every mobile phone needs a steady AC signal of an exact frequency. An oscillator makes it from a plain DC supply, with no input at all.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ರೇಡಿಯೋ ಕೇಂದ್ರ, ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಗಡಿಯಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್‌ಗೆ ನಿಖರ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ AC ಸಂಕೇತ ಬೇಕು. ಆಂದೋಲಕ ಯಾವುದೇ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ DC ಸರಬರಾಜಿನಿಂದಲೇ ಅದನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain oscillations in an LC tank circuit

narration.en: Every radio station, every computer clock and every mobile phone needs a steady AC signal of an exact frequency. An oscillator makes it from a plain DC supply, with no input at all.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ರೇಡಿಯೋ ಕೇಂದ್ರ, ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಗಡಿಯಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್‌ಗೆ ನಿಖರ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ AC ಸಂಕೇತ ಬೇಕು. ಆಂದೋಲಕ ಯಾವುದೇ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ DC ಸರಬರಾಜಿನಿಂದಲೇ ಅದನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: An oscillator converts DC power into AC of a desired frequency without any input signal. In an LC tank circuit, a charged capacitor discharges through the inductor; the current builds a magnetic field, which then collapses and recharges the capacitor the other way. Energy swaps between the electric field of C and the magnetic field of L at $f = 1/(2\pi\sqrt{LC})$. Every real circuit has resistance, so energy is lost as heat and the oscillations die out: they are damped. To get sustained (undamped) oscillations, the lost energy must be supplied in the correct phase every cycle by an amplifier with positive feedback.

narration.en: In a tank circuit energy swings between the capacitor and the coil at one over two pi root LC. Losses damp it, so an amplifier with positive feedback must make up the loss.
narration.kn: ಟ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಮಂಡಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಧಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸುರುಳಿಯ ನಡುವೆ f = 1/(2π√LC) ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓಲಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಷ್ಟಗಳಿಂದ ಆಂದೋಲನಗಳು ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆಯ ವರ್ಧಕ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: On the board: from tank circuit to oscillator.

say.en: A charged capacitor discharges through the coil. Energy swaps between the electric field of C and the magnetic field of L at f equal to one over two pi root LC.
Real coils have resistance, so each swing is smaller: the oscillations die out. These are damped oscillations.
If an amplifier puts back the lost energy in the right phase every cycle, the oscillations continue with constant amplitude.
The amplifier gives 180 degrees, the network another 180. The loop gain must be one and the total phase 360 degrees: the Barkhausen criterion.

body.en: An oscillator has three parts: a frequency-determining network (tank or RC network), an amplifier, and a positive feedback path. Oscillations are sustained when (1) the loop gain $|A\beta| = 1$ and (2) the total phase shift around the loop is 0° or 360°. A CE amplifier gives 180°, so the feedback network must give another 180°. In practice $A\beta$ is made slightly more than 1 so that oscillations start from noise and grow; the amplitude then settles where $A\beta = 1$.

narration.en: Barkhausen criterion: the loop gain must be one and the total phase shift around the loop zero or three hundred and sixty degrees.
narration.kn: ಬಾರ್ಕ್‌ಹೌಸೆನ್ ನಿಯಮ: ಲೂಪ್ ವರ್ಧನೆ Aβ = 1 ಮತ್ತು ಲೂಪ್‌ನ ಒಟ್ಟು ಹಂತ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ 0° ಅಥವಾ 360° ಆಗಿರಬೇಕು.

homework.en: Explain with diagrams how oscillations are produced in a tank circuit and why they are damped.

narration.en: Recap. An oscillator turns DC into AC with no input signal. Tank circuit frequency f = 1/(2π√LC). Losses cause damping; positive feedback sustains oscillations. Barkhausen: Aβ = 1 and loop phase 0° or 360°.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಂದೋಲಕ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ DC ಯನ್ನು AC ಆಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಟ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಮಂಡಲದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ f = 1/(2π√LC). ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಕ್ಷೀಣತೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ; ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ ಆಂದೋಲನ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಾರ್ಕ್‌ಹೌಸೆನ್: Aβ = 1 ಮತ್ತು ಲೂಪ್ ಹಂತ 0° ಅಥವಾ 360°.
